title: PRD-08 synthetic risk input syntax

insuredRef.description: required; authorized person and underwriting purpose. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: INSURED_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

birthDate.description: required; valid nonfuture date with calendar source. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: BIRTH_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

occupationCode.description: conditional; versioned risk classification <= 40. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: OCCUPATION_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

beneficiaries.description: required before issue; 1–100 party refs with allocation basis points summing 10000 when percentage allocation applies. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: BENEFICIARY_ALLOCATION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contributionAmount.description: required; positive; explicit schedule/currency. Sensitivity: financial. Error: CONTRIBUTION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contributionFrequency.description: required; contract-offered schedule code. Sensitivity: financial. Error: FREQUENCY_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

illustrationVersion.description: conditional for projection; approved document/version <= 80. Sensitivity: financial. Error: ILLUSTRATION_UNAPPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

medicalDeclarationRef.description: conditional; restricted member-specific record. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: MEDICAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
